title: Sketchpad Metabolism Kit Vfs Empty
description: When double-clicking metabolism kit in sketchpad home VFS, the kit VFS shows no items. Fix root cause and add test coverage.
summary:
Fixed empty kit VFS after home double-click on Metabolism (or any second open kit).

Root cause: kit VFS expanded-node state is per app surface, not per kit. Visiting another kit left the previous kit id expanded, so the new kit root stayed collapsed and showed no children.

- Added syncVirtualFileSystemRoute to rebind expansion and clear lazy children when the routed root changes.
- SketchpadAppVirtualFileSystem calls it for kit/design VFS on each snapshot.
- Pointed metabolism dev fixture and mesh URLs at /fixtures/kit/dev/metabolism/... (assets tree absent locally).
- Unit test: switching between two open kits shows the correct type rows.

Tests: vitest Sketchpad kit virtual file system + sketchpadKitFileUrlById (4 passed).
